I've never met an anorexic who was initially triggered by beauty standards and the media. Everyone says that's the cause, but I've not heard a single first hand account. Most people I know with EDs say that their parents (particularly moms) were obsessed with diets and weight in a really unhealthy way and it was just an adopted behavior. There are other factors of course, but that seems to be a common risk factor.

Recovered anorexic here and 'beauty standards and the media' has very very very little to do with someone developing anorexia.
